RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

The panel's gender composition alone is not evidence of bias. In banking, senior leadership roles like Head of Risk Modelling frequently weigh regulatory compliance, supervisory relationships, and governance equally with or above quantitative depth. Furthermore, two weeks is a standard delay for formal HR feedback.

Raising allegations of discrimination without documentation or concrete proof will appear defensive and could seriously damage your professional reputation across the financial sector. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting a developmental debrief to understand where the successful candidate stood out. Revisit your options only if you uncover clear, documented evidence that protected characteristics influenced the evaluation.
